import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert the 'date' column to datetime
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])

# Aggregate total sales by product and date
sales_by_product = data.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Create a line plot for sales over time by product
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=sales_by_product, x='date', y='total', hue='product', marker='o')

# Set plot labels and title
plt.title('Daily Sales by Product')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product')
plt.grid(True)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Aggregate total sales by product and date
sales_by_product = data.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=sales_by_product, x='date', y='total', hue='product', marker='o')

plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
